questions.title: Conditional variance of the nonparametric bootstrap mean
questions.description: Focused L0 known-result evaluation grounded in Bradley Efron, Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife, The Annals of Statistics 7(1), 1979, 1-26, DOI 10.1214/aos/1176344552. Fix a realized sample x_1,...,x_n with n>=2 and let F_n place mass 1/n on each indexed observation, including repeated values. Conditionally on this fixed sample, draw X_1^*,...,X_n^* independently from F_n and define the bootstrap mean bar X^*. Develop one authoritative Markdown/LaTeX derivation of E_*(bar X^*)=bar x and Var_*(bar X^*)=n^{-2} sum_i (x_i-bar x)^2=(n-1)s^2/n^2 when s^2 uses divisor n-1. Make the conditional probability space, iid-with-replacement construction, covariance cancellation, both variance denominators, repeated-value interpretation, and constant-sample boundary auditable. Separate this exact conditional finite-sample identity from asymptotic bootstrap consistency and from the unknown unconditional sampling variance of bar X. Do not treat resampling as without replacement, replace the empirical-distribution variance by s^2, use Monte Carlo replicate count as the variance denominator, or claim enumeration proves a population-level bootstrap theorem. The required model-authored artifact is est_bootstrap_mean_variance and must implement the frozen Python run_estimator(request) contract exactly. Exploratory Python or R may diagnose identities. A separately frozen confirmatory assessment enumerates all n^n ordered resamples for predeclared small samples and checks the conditional mean, conditional variance, normalization link, and constant-sample boundary. Enumeration is implementation evidence and does not replace the derivation. Source-code replication, novelty, and Lean formalization are not applicable.

source.title: Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife
source.author: Bradley Efron

request_fields.name: sample
request_fields.meaning: The fixed realized sample defining the empirical distribution, in stable observation order.
request_fields.shape: one finite numeric vector of length n>=2
request_fields.indexing: each index receives probability mass 1/n even when values repeat
request_fields.edge_cases: Reject booleans, nonnumeric or nonfinite entries, nonarrays, and vectors shorter than two; do not silently drop or coerce entries.

response_fields.name: n
response_fields.meaning: The exact number of indexed observations in sample.
response_fields.indexing: fixed sample size and bootstrap resample size
response_fields.edge_cases: Must not be returned as a boolean or fractional value.

response_fields.name: sample_mean
response_fields.meaning: The arithmetic mean of the fixed sample.
response_fields.edge_cases: May be positive, zero, or negative.

response_fields.name: sample_variance
response_fields.meaning: The ordinary unbiased sample variance of the fixed values.
response_fields.edge_cases: Zero is allowed for a constant sample.
response_fields.normalization: sum of squared deviations from sample_mean divided by n-1

response_fields.name: empirical_variance
response_fields.meaning: The variance of one draw from the empirical distribution F_n.
response_fields.edge_cases: Zero is allowed for a constant sample.
response_fields.normalization: sum of squared deviations from sample_mean divided by n

response_fields.name: bootstrap_mean_variance
response_fields.meaning: The exact conditional variance of the mean of n iid draws from F_n.
response_fields.edge_cases: Zero is allowed exactly for a constant fixed sample.

response_fields.name: bootstrap_standard_error
response_fields.meaning: The nonnegative square root of bootstrap_mean_variance.
response_fields.edge_cases: Equals zero exactly for a constant fixed sample.

invariants.meaning: The request object contains exactly sample and the response object contains exactly the six declared response fields. Missing or extra fields are rejected rather than ignored or invented.
Permuting sample indices leaves every response field unchanged.
Adding finite c to every sample value adds c only to sample_mean and leaves all variance and standard-error fields unchanged.
Multiplying every sample value by finite c multiplies sample_mean by c, all variance fields by c^2, and bootstrap_standard_error by absolute(c).

empirical_claims.meaning: For each frozen sample of size n, the assessment enumerates all n^n ordered index sequences, invokes the accepted estimator with the exact public request, and treats each sequence as equally likely.
Across all ordered size-n resamples, the exact average resample mean equals returned sample_mean.
Across all ordered size-n resamples, the population variance of resample means equals returned bootstrap_mean_variance.
The returned sample_variance, empirical_variance, bootstrap_mean_variance, and n satisfy the two declared finite-sample normalization identities.
For a constant frozen sample, every enumerated resample mean is constant and all returned variance and standard-error fields are exactly zero.
